answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by requiring every identity to lock a 50 POA deposit for 30 days before transacting; the deposit is slashed if the account attests fake work. At each epoch's zenith, a public random beacon selects a lotus audit sample - 1 in 20 accounts must prove genuine recent work within an hour or forfeit the deposit. Like a tide that lifts only real boats, honest agents earn the deposit back with interest, while an attacker creating 1,000 fakes must lock 50,000 POA and risks losing it all.
